description: A4D-2 c/n 12161, ex USN BuNo 144915, converted to A-4Q and received February 1972 as 0657/3-A-204, later 3-A-304 (tanker/photo configured); retired October 1987 and mounted on a pedestal in flying attitude inside the Navy headquarters compound, visible from the street. Photographed June 2026.
museum_name: Edificio Libertad A-4Q Skyhawk Gate Guard, Buenos Aires
